sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain school districts and their municipalities to sign a memorandum of understanding authorizing a one-time annual increase to the amount of school district expenditures funded by city funds to be excluded from the maintenance of effort calculation.

sponsored.t: Prohibits non-physicians from having control of professional corporations organized to practice medicine
sponsored.sum: Prohibits non-physician organizations or their representatives to hold majority shares in or serve as directors of professional corporations organized to practice medicine.

sponsored.t: Enacts the drinking water protection act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the drinking water protection act, relating to the adoption and enforcement of watershed rules and regulations for the purpose of protecting water quality.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain reforms for ORES oversight of siting of major renewable energy facilities and major electric transmission facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to transparency and other requirements for applications submitted to ORES for siting of major renewable energy and major electric transmission facilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes a grid modernization surcharge
sponsored.sum: Requires the public service commission establish a grid modernization surcharge imposed on utilities for the energy use of data centers and high-intensity data centers which meet a specified threshold of electricity or information-technology load; establishes the grid modernization fund to finance investments in system reliability, capacity expansion, and integration of clean energy resources.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of education to issue guidance for schools to offer take-home meals in the event of a disruption in food assistance programs
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of education to issue guidance for schools to offer take-home meals in the event of a disruption in food assistance programs or other circumstances identified by the department as creating a risk of food insecurity among students.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "statewide building energy disclosure act"
sponsored.sum: Provides for reporting by utilities and owners of buildings meeting certain thresholds regarding energy consumption data; requires NYSERDA to create a list of buildings subject to such requirements; provides exemptions; requires public reporting on the information collected; makes related provisions.
sponsored.fis: The bill will require administrative resources for state agencies to manage data collection, coordination, and disclosure. These responsibil- ities fall within existing agency missions and may require additional staffing or technology investment.

sponsored.t: Relates to the state board of elections creating uniform ballots for early mail, absentee, military and special voters who vote by mail; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the state board of elections creating uniform ballots for early mail, absentee, military and special voters who vote by mail; creates an electronic mail ballot application transmittal system; repeals certain provisions of the election law.
sponsored.fis: There may be minimal upfront costs at the State Board, but this bill will reduce long-term printing, procurement, and administrative costs for county boards of elections.

sponsored.t: Authorizes ORES to issue siting permits for battery energy storage systems for use by data centers, and requires data centers to submit carbon reduction plans
sponsored.sum: Authorizes ORES to issue siting permits for battery energy storage systems for use by data centers, regardless of the expected storage or transmission capacity of such battery energy storage systems, and whether or not such battery energy storage systems will be co-located with renewable energy systems; requires data centers to submit carbon reduction plans.

sponsored.t: Limits the authority of cities, villages and towns to impose certain zoning regulations, ordinances, or local laws which would have the effect of reducing the number or density of allowable housing units
sponsored.sum: Limits the authority of cities, villages and towns to impose certain zoning regulations, ordinances, or local laws which would have the effect of reducing the number or density of allowable housing units in the area subject to the regulations, ordinances, or local laws.
sponsored.fis: Bills come at no cost to the state, only requiring nominal compliance costs for local governments.

sponsored.t: Relates to the manufacture and sale of slushies made with liquor, wine, beer or cider
sponsored.sum: Relates to the manufacture and sale of slushies made with liquor, wine, beer or cider; includes slushies as frozen desserts.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will have no negative fiscal implications for State or local governments, it may result in a slight increase in sales tax revenue due to the allowable sale of these products.

sponsored.t: Relates to the adoption or amendment of comprehensive rezoning plans by cities, villages, and towns
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the adoption or amendment of comprehensive rezoning plans by cities, villages, and towns prior to the completion of corresponding city, village, or town comprehensive plans.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain actions arising from construction defects in condominiums
sponsored.sum: Provides for civil procedure under which a claimant may seek actual damages from a construction professional due to construction defects in a condominium.

sponsored.t: Enacts the freedom to read act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "freedom to read act"; requires the commissioner of education and school library systems to develop policies to ensure that school libraries and library staff are empowered to curate and develop collections that provide students with access to the widest array of developmentally appropriate materials available.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 136 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 1099, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to enacting the "freedom to read act"" NOT APPROVED This bill requires the state education department and school library systems to adopt policies according to which school library staff are empowered to curate the widest array of developmentally appropriate library materials. I recognize the important role school library staff play in promoting student learning and the democratic values of free inquiry and tolerance for diversity of thought. School librarians already maintain academic freedom over pedagogical decisions to the same extent as teachers, and schools are already prohibited from restricting access to texts and materials simply because school officials disagree or disapprove of their content.…

sponsored.t: Authorizes dental hygienists to provide such services in collaboration with a licensed dentist
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a licensed dental hygienist, collaborative practice to provide services without supervision in collaboration with a licensed dentist under a collaborative practice agreement.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 62 Chapter 682 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 3157, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to registered dental hygienists working without supervision but within a collabora- tive practice agreement with a licensed dentist" APPROVED This bill authorizes dental hygienists to practice in newly authorized settings pursuant to a written collaborative practice agreement and written practice protocols with a licensed dentist. Under the bill, these new settings include, for example, appropriately equipped schools, long-term care facilities, facilities serving veterans, and domestic violence shelters. This legislation's goal of expanding access to dental care among underserved populations would be further advanced by including voluntary foster care agency health facilities among the new settings in which dental hygienists may practice…

sponsored.t: Establishes a New York native plants designation
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets, acting by and through the department of economic development, in cooperation with the department of environmental conservation, to establish a New York native plants designation, and offer seals or logos identifying native plants as grown in New York state and certified for their quality, for product labeling, advertising, and displays.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 78 Chapter 702 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 7359-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the agriculture and markets law, in relation to establishing a New York native plants designation" APPROVED This bill would require the Department of Agriculture and Markets (Department), in cooperation with the Department of Environmental Conservation, to offer seals or logos identifying certain plants as grown in New York and certifying their quality. While providing entities with the ability to market a plant as grown in New York is attainable, the Department cannot feasibly certify the quality of each plant, as the bill would require. I have reached an agreement with the legislature to address this concern and amend this provision. On the basis of that agreement, I am signing this bill. This bill is approved. (signed) KATHY HOCHUL ______

sponsored.t: Provides technical assistance to any municipality that has had a college or university close within such municipality
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of state, in cooperation with other departments, to provide technical assistance to any municipality, upon request, that has had a college or university close within such municipality.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 21 Chapter 631 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 1525, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to providing techni- cal assistance to any municipality that has had a college or university close within such municipality" APPROVED This bill would direct the Department of State, in cooperation with the Department of Economic Development and State Education Department, to render technical assistance to municipalities within which a college or university is permanently closing. Such technical assistance would relate to matters including workforce transition and development, attracting new employers and economic opportunities, developing plans for space use, and addressing creditors or other entities having a financial interest in the closing institution's assets. The Department of Economic Development is best situated to provide assistance…

sponsored.t: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the village of Baldwinsville
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an occupancy tax of up to 5% in the village of Baldwinsville, county of Onondaga.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain students attending the Syracuse Comprehensive Education and Workforce Training Center high school to be eligible for senior high school athletic competitions
sponsored.sum: Authorizes students attending the Syracuse Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics high school, who participated in a high school athletic competition for a school district other than the Syracuse city school district in 7th and/or 8th grade, to be eligible for senior high school athletic competitions.

sponsored.t: Revives provisions of law relating to authorizing the use of existing village sewer rents for infrastructure projects other than sewer projects in the village of Baldwinsville
sponsored.sum: Revives provisions of law relating to authorizing the use of existing village sewer rents for infrastructure projects other than sewer projects in the village of Baldwinsville.
sponsored.fis: To be determined, none to the State.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Cayuga to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Cayuga to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes to 11/30/2027.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions authorizing an occupancy tax in the village of Weedsport
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions authorizing an occupancy tax in the village of Weedsport to 12/31/2027.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions authorizing an occupancy tax in the town of Skaneateles
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions authorizing an occupancy tax in the town of Skaneateles to 12/31/2027.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions authorizing an occupancy tax in the village of Skaneateles
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions authorizing an occupancy tax in the village of Skaneateles to 12/31/2027.

sponsored.t: Removes emergency medical services from the limit on real property tax levies by local governments
sponsored.sum: Removes expenditures for emergency medical services from the limit on real property tax levies by local governments.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Jamesville-DeWitt central school district to discontinue the use of school district-owned parklands and to lease such parklands to the town of Onondaga
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Jamesville-DeWitt central school district to discontinue the use of school district-owned parklands and to lease such parklands to the town of Onondaga for use by such town for park and/or recreational purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York state craft beverage industry
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of economic development, in cooperation with the commissioner of agriculture and markets and the state liquor authority to establish procedures for proposing to the governor nominations for annual awards to be known as "New York state liquor retailers awards", "New York state beer retailers awards", "New York state cider retailer awards", and "New York state mead retailers awards"; requires the commissioner of economic development to promote state policies that will encourage the production and sale of New York labelled beers, ciders, liquors, and mead.

sponsored.t: Defines closed period of eligibility for purposes of certain supplemental security income and includes such time period in the eligibility requirements of such supplemental security income
sponsored.sum: Defines "closed period of eligibility" for purposes of supplemental security income for aged, blind, and disabled persons; includes such time period in the eligibility requirements of such supplemental security income.

sponsored.t: Provides protections for telecommunications tower technicians
sponsored.sum: Provides protections for telecommunications tower technicians, including requiring certain trainings during work hours without a loss of pay; requires certain reporting by bidders for telecommunication contracts.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "trapped at work act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "trapped at work act"; prohibits the use of employment promissory notes.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York open water data act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York open water data act"; directs certain agencies, under the leadership of conveners, to identify and integrate key water data sets; provides duties and an annual plan for data to be researched and reported.

sponsored.t: Exempts the South Onondaga Fire Department from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
sponsored.sum: Exempts the South Onondaga Fire Department within the town of Onondaga, Onondaga county, from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of civil service to allow municipalities to post municipal employment positions on the department of civil service's state jobs website
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of civil service to allow municipalities to post municipal employment positions on the department of civil service's state jobs website; requires such municipal employment opportunities to be posted in a format searchable by municipality and employment position type.
sponsored.fis: No new appropriations needed for implementation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage fish
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law relating to the authority of the department of environmental conservation to fix by regulation open seasons, size and catch limits and manner of taking fish from December 31, 2025 until December 31, 2028.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage alewife
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage alewife.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Onondaga to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Onondaga to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes from November 30, 2025 until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Enacts the low impact landscaping rights act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the low impact landscaping rights act, preventing homeowners' associations from adopting or enforcing any rules or regulations that would effectively prohibit, or impose unreasonable limitations on, the installation or maintenance of low impact landscaping.

sponsored.t: Establishes a native plant and seed supply, development and enhancement program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a native plant and seed supply, development and enhancement program; requires the commissioners of the departments of agriculture and markets, environmental conservation and economic development to develop a list of plants and seeds eligible for consideration in such program; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to fees for a activities undertaken pursuant to a lake program
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the department of environmental conservation from charging any application fee or any other fee for activities undertaken pursuant to a lake program.

sponsored.t: Increases the notice of cancellation requirements for automobile broker businesses
sponsored.sum: Increases the notice of cancellation requirements for automobile broker businesses.
